OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_GU_RANK_UP.d: Select Gu Worms to refine in one go. Each refinement has 2 slots: a mortal Gu Worm takes 1 slot and an immortal Gu Worm takes 2 slots, so you can refine up to 2 mortal or 1 immortal Gu Worm. Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_GU_RANK_UP.s: Select Gu Worms to refine (mortal takes 1 slot each, immortal takes 2 slots each, 2 slots total). You may also confirm with 0 selected.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.desc: First select a currently craftable Gu card, then select Gu Worm materials matching that target. Materials are consumed and the result is created only when both types and quantities match; failed attempts do not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.sele: Select materials matching the target Gu card, then confirm.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_PERSONAL_HE_LIAN.targ: First select the Gu card to craft. Only materials that can match the target will be shown next.
